summary: Reviewed installer against AC1-AC5: isolated real CLI install, persistent shell home/default-home symlink, merge privacy and conflicts, discard/cancel guards, optional prerequisite and retry checks; native Codex reads enabled core and optional MCP definitions. Functional inventory regressions pass. Remote provider execution/authentication, live desktop restart and active-machine migration are outside this delivered installer verification. Historical inventory snapshot assertion and tracked fixture gate failures predate this change.
